note: v3354: v3349 gave the ledger a partial counter - how many looks never saw part of the change - which was the right question pointed at everything. MEASURED 2026-09-19 over the 7 rows carrying absent: it flagged 7 of 7, and 12 of their 16 absent-file entries were bible.html or tv/tv_diablo.py changed by exactly two lines, both carrying a version token. Only TWO rows missed anything a reviewer could have held an opinion about - v3349, filed clean over a payload that never contained its own 218-line subject, and v3351. A warning that fires on every row carries no information, which is the same defect as a gate that is always green. THE FIX CLASSIFIES THE CHANGE, NEVER THE FILENAME, and the obvious allow-list was measured and REFUSED before building: across the last 120 version commits six files change in at least 99 percent of them - WINDOWS_SHIP.json, TASKS.md, tv_diablo.py, bible.html, control_app.py and BLUEPRINT.md - and two of those are the files most often the real subject of a version. One filename, opposite verdicts: bible.html at e850b847 is SUBSTANTIVE at 37 changed lines, the apostrophe fold, and at c08875ad is STAMP at 2 lines both version tokens; control_app.py at d2b3f3cf is SUBSTANTIVE at 8 lines, the rider route, and at c08875ad is STAMP. An allow-list would excuse both substantive rows - a genuinely blind look waved through on the day one of those files IS the subject. THREE STATES match absent exactly: a dict is measured, empty is measured and nothing missing, null means reach was never established which is all 867 prior rows, and those are classified ON READ from their own sha - the same measurement from the same source taken later, never assumed to be stamps and never rewritten. UNKNOWN IS NEVER AN EXCUSE: the classifier only ever REMOVES a warning and may do so only where a stamp was MEASURED, so a diff nobody could read stays outside the excuse. THE FALSE-NEGATIVE DIRECTION WAS HUNTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED AWAY: swept across 80 version commits, every stamp-classified change to a file this classifier can be handed is exactly 2 lines - bible.html 2/2/2 over n=71, tv_diablo.py 2/2/2 over n=80, control_app.py 2/2/2 over n=52. The only large all-version-token diffs are TASKS.md at up to 9 lines and WINDOWS_SHIP.json at 4, and neither can ever reach the classifier because absent_from asks git for python, mjs, sh and html only - a bound this law pins rather than trusts. Classified AT THE DOOR inside record() so no caller can forget to take the measurement. LIVE EFFECT on his ledger: partial goes 7 of 7 to 2 of 7, and both survivors now NAME the file nobody saw instead of merely counting. 477 gates, 11 cases, 4 red-proofs PROVEN. ⚠ THE ELEVENTH CASE EXISTS BECAUSE A SABOTAGE WAS RIGHT AND MY TEST WAS WEAK: red-proof 2 flipped the fall-through value of absent_kind from unknown to stamp and this file stayed entirely GREEN, because nothing ever drove a sha git cannot resolve - the two unknown cases only reached the literal early-return for an empty argument. That is regression-guard section 5a cause 2, the test too weak to see the change rather than the guard blind, and it matters because stamp is the value that SILENCES the warning: an unreadable diff quietly excusing a blind look is this version defect arriving through the error path. HEART, and the bump gate was right to demand it: a new corroborator second-eye-reach puts the STORED absentKind against the same files re-derived from the commit by git - two genuinely different engines, the left one reading the dict and nothing else so it cannot share a callee with the right. A disagreement means the persisted classification no longer describes the commit it names, which is the stale-reading section 4 shape: a verdict with no expiry, written once and trusted forever, and stamp is the value that SILENCES a warning. ⚠ AND ITS FIRST RUN SHIPPED GREEN AT 0 EQUALS 0 - no row carries absentKind yet, so both sides summed over nothing and the pair reported perfect agreement about a comparison that never happened. An empty population now returns UNKNOWN and the row reads white, not green: the confident zero this repo keeps re-learning to distrust, committed inside the corroborator built to catch it. The gate count is 477, and this sentence used to say 478 - a number I appended without recounting after the corroborator went in, which adds no gate. An inherited claim is not evidence, including one from my own prior sentence.
